signals.name: maxDepth
signals.quantity: maximum recursion depth of Composer.composeNode during one execution
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in v1.DepthCounters, index [1] = max depth
signals.reset: DepthCounters.reset() called by V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

signals.name: nodeCount
signals.quantity: total number of calls to Composer.composeNode during one execution
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in v1.DepthCounters, index [2] = node count
signals.reset: DepthCounters.reset() called by V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

plans.retention: Primary: keep input if maxDepth exceeds the current corpus best. Secondary (when maxDepth is flat or zero): keep inputs that are longer than previously retained inputs (growth toward input_bytes=4001) or that produce a non-zero nodeCount for the first time. Prioritization: weight corpus entries by maxDepth+1 for parent selection during mutation.
mutation: Byte-level: random bit flip at random position; random byte insertion; random byte deletion; random byte replacement

Repetition [R45a]: select a random contiguous region [start, start+len), copy it k times in place (k random, bounded by MAX_INPUT_SIZE), growing nesting-dense regions exponentially; includes whole-input doubling

Dictionary [R45b]: tokens from the Scanner source on the attack path — single chars: '[', ']', '{', '}', ',', ':', '-', '*', '&', '!', '\n'; multi-char: '---', '...'. Insert or overwrite at random positions
No encoder needed [R45c]: YAML is plain text with no checksums or length fields
